You'll gain control of Alice in Prague. Start heading north, but hug the right
side of the area. Before Alice reappears, you should see a '?' icon; examine
here to find a [_ZODIAC BRACELET_]. Go north to the next area and use the Save
Point you see here. Once you've saved, talk to the sleeping guy here, and
you'll find out that he's a Lottery Member!

The ring here EXTREMELY SLOW, so it should be VERY easy to get whatever you
want! Make sure to win the Brsrkr Earrings before continuing on; it increases
your max HP 20%! If you don't win it, reload your last save and try again.
Remember, you need to win something from each member at least once!

Keep following along the path past the bar, but before going to the next area,
step off to the right onto the raised platform near the building at the top of
the screen. Search the south end of the platform to find a [_KIRIN SCALE_],
then go north to the next area. Check behind the tree to your left, and you
should find a chest containing a [_LOTTERY TICKET_]. Once you have it, go back
to the last area and enter the bar.

  NOTE     Save your shopping until the next town, since we'll get a better
¯¯¯¯¯¯¯¯   Guild Card there. Unless, of course, you absolutely need healing
           items and such.

Examine the table above the woman on your left (Peddler Rosa) to find a
[_PRIEST'S WINE_], then talk to Peddler Rosa to have Zhuzhen come back out.
Talk to him to progress the story, and when you regain control, head north to
the castle walls, where you'll encounter a new foe and have to face some of her
monsters.

After you defeat them, you'll be back in the bar. Grab anything you absolutely
need from the peddler here, then leave the bar. If for some reason you want to
talk to Meiyuan for some Acupuncture or want something from the Silent Peddler,
both are now at the north end of town. When you're finished, leave Prague. Head
to our next destination: Bistritz.
